units.rawText: <size=28>She's definitely got the skills. But she was made as a guzheng Doll; if she couldn't even do this much, she wouldn't have gotten an audition slot.</size>

units.rawText: <size=28>We're going to see if she can convey the poise of a guzheng expert combined with the panic of her immaturity. Being able to show off these contradictory emotions is key.</size>
